name: Buttons
description: A spilled tin of sewing buttons in mixed colors and sizes, each with a raised lip and two or four holes right through it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --holes: @p(@var(--h2), @var(--h4)); transform: translate(@r(-12%, 12%), @r(-12%, 12%)) rotate(@r(0deg, 360deg)) scale(@r(.62, 1.05)); z-index: @ri(1, 9); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--holes); mask: @var(--holes); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 13%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); opacity: .55; -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 84%, #000 84% 100%, transparent 100%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 84%, #000 84% 100%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --h2: radial-gradient(circle at 41% 50%, transparent 7.24%, #000 7.24%), radial-gradient(circle at 59% 50%, transparent 7.24%, #000 7.24%); --h4: radial-gradient(circle at 41.5% 41.5%, transparent 6.04%, #000 6.04%), radial-gradient(circle at 58.5% 41.5%, transparent 6.04%, #000 6.04%), radial-gradient(circle at 41.5% 58.5%, transparent 6.04%, #000 6.04%), radial-gradient(circle at 58.5% 58.5%, transparent 6.04%, #000 6.04%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
